'''Hondo Ohnaka''' kept at least one '''massiff''' as a '''pet''', who was tended to by one of his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] members. After his [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate outpost]] was destroyed during the [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|Second battle of Florrum]], [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Ohnaka]] escaped aboard [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] with his surviving men, his [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]], as well as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] in her care. When Ohnaka safely delivered the wayward Jedi to [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|cruiser]], his pet entertained itself by gnawing on a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] head.<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />
